subject: POC risk tracker & success criteria - Stellar Commerce
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aiden Cooper <aiden@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC risk tracker & success criteria - Stellar Commerce

Thanks again for the call earlier, Aiden - good alignment. Recap and next steps below.

Summary / success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 600ms for our mapped request types
- Cost: baseline tokens/unit and target per-request cost as discussed (see checklist)
- Quality: pass 3 golden prompts + 50 sample prompts with >90% parity vs your internal human evals
- Security: trial data must remain in-region (US) and only stored in the staging environment for evaluation

Evaluation plan / ownership:
- Redwood will provision a staging environment and a sample evaluation harness (Marissa / Dev)
- Stellar will provide test dataset, security contacts, and procurement approvals for temporary AWS account (Aiden / Samantha / Procurement)
- Weekly syncs to track blockers and results (proposed cadence below)

Proposed timeline:
- Week 1 (Aug 2-6): access & staging setup, grant test dataset, initial smoke tests
- Week 2 (Aug 9-13): run evaluation harness, collect metrics
- Week 3 (Aug 16-20): iterate on tuning and finalize acceptance

Risks to surface now: data residency requirement; possible networking/VPC peering constraints; procurement timeline for temporary accounts.

Attachments: poc-plan-v1.pdf, evaluation-checklist.xlsx

Asks: please confirm the success criteria and name the internal owner for the evaluation (who will own signoff). Also confirm any compliance contacts we should loop in.

Thanks!
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

Forwarding Aiden's note. Rishi / Dev - can you triage the data residency ask and flag any infra blockers? Key items:
- Can we host the staging environment in a US-only AWS account?
- Any known issues with peering to Stellar's S3-compatible endpoints?
- ETA for a mitigated setup if peering is not possible (temporary staging account, signed data processing addendum, etc.)

I attached a short tech reqs doc with what's needed from engineering. Please advise by EOD Tue (Aug 4) so I can update the customer.

Attachment: tech-reqs.md
—Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Aiden Cooper <aiden@stellarcommerce.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@stellarcommerce.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC risk tracker & success criteria - Stellar Commerce

Thanks for the ping - quick triage notes from infra: 
- We can provision a US-only staging environment (no transit outside us-east/us-west regions) - that part is OK.
- Potential blocking issue: Stellar is using a custom S3-compatible endpoint behind VPC endpoints that do not support the standard AWS VPC peering flow we rely on. Attempting peering as-is fails auth/route exchange. See brief logs.
- Mitigation options:
  1) Temporary staging on a Redwood-managed AWS account with a staged copy of the test data (we'd need a signed DPA and procurement approval) - lowest friction for testing
  2) Implement a proxy/connector to that S3 endpoint (engineer effort ~3-5 days) - allows direct connectivity but adds work and potentially performance variance
  3) If peering is required, escalate to our cloud networking team to open a dedicated circuit (timeline 1-2 weeks)

Escalation path: if procurement cannot approve a temporary account within 3 business days, we should engage the cloud networking escalation (rishi -> vp infra).

Attachment: vpc-peering-issues.log

I'll prepare a short proposed staging setup and timeline for acceptance testing once we choose path (1) or (2).


Dev

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aiden Cooper <aiden@stellarcommerce.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@stellarcommerce.com>, procurement@stellarcommerce.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC risk tracker & success criteria - Stellar Commerce

Thanks Dev - helpful triage. Aiden / Samantha - based on infra feedback, proposed path forward:
- We provision a temporary Redwood-managed AWS staging account in the US and ingest a redacted copy of your test dataset. This keeps data in-region and avoids peering fragility for the initial trial.
- Procurement: please review the attached proposed staging setup and the DPA language; we can send a DocuSign envelope for approval. Link below.
- Timeline update: if procurement signs within 3 business days, we can stand up staging and run smoke tests by Aug 9; otherwise we will pursue option (2) which pushes the evaluation window by ~1 week.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/XYZ-DocuSign-Envelope-12345

Asks: please acknowledge this plan and confirm procurement ETA so we can lock the evaluation window. Also confirming escalation path: Rishi will escalate to VP infra if procurement delays >3 business days.

Marissa
